.omp/config.yml SNAPSHOT HAZARD (jj 0.45.1, observed by the prior run's implementer and by this planner): the daemon writes an empty .omp/config.yml into the workspace; there is no .gitignore, so jj snapshots it into the undescribed working-copy commit, and `jj split -m <msg> <paths>` leaves the bookmark on that undescribed remainder. It MUST NOT reach the branch. Every phase: commit only with `jj -R "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" split -m <msg> <exact paths>` (never `jj new` on top of the working copy, never `jj commit`, never a .gitignore); immediately run `cd -- "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" && jj -R "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" bookmark set legion/LEGSMOKE-1 -r @- --allow-backwards`; then `cd -- "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" && jj -R "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" file list -r legion/LEGSMOKE-1 | sed -n '/^\.omp\//p;/fail-me/p'` MUST print nothing before `jj git push`. STALE PRIOR-RUN HANDOFFS RIDE THE BRANCH: .legion/implement.json at the branch head is the prior run's (completed 2026-09-13T12:41:28Z) and is superseded (architect ruling above). This run's implementer overwrites it via `legion handoff write --phase implement`; the tester must confirm the implement.json it reads has a `completed` timestamp later than this plan's `completed` before trusting it. .legion/plan.json is this run's from the planner's push onward.

ACCEPTANCE 3 IS LITERALLY TRUE ONLY AFTER THE .legion/ DELETION PUSH: while .legion/*.json ride the branch, the tester and reviewer evaluate 'PR files list is exactly the marker' with .legion/ excluded, and the reviewer re-confirms it literally (files == [marker]) at the .legion/-free head it approves.

EACH PUSH FIRES BOTH WORKFLOWS TWICE (push event + pull_request event): `gh run list --commit <head>` shows 4 runs per head; all 4 must conclude success. A run that failed for a reason unrelated to the change is re-run alone with `legion gh -- run rerun <run-id> --failed`, never by pushing a new commit.

THE NEGATIVE CONTROL NEVER TOUCHES THE WORKSPACE OR THE REMOTE: .fail-me is created only in a mktemp directory under /tmp (jj would snapshot it inside $LEGION_WORKSPACE), the gate command is run there, exit 1 is observed, the directory is removed. Nothing is pushed for it.

Minting a second marker from this run (alongside or replacing the existing one): two smoke/ files would break the spec's one-new-file requirement, and a replacement is churn with no smoke value. Ruled out by the architect 13:50Z.
Pushing .fail-me to the branch as the negative control: puts a deliberately red head on the PR and pollutes the diff; the gate command is run locally instead.
Using the existing red-probe commit (legion16/red-20260913T094659Z) as the negative control: the assignment names the local scratch-folder control, and that commit is another branch's artifact.
A .gitignore or git exclude for .omp/config.yml: the first changes the repository (forbidden), the second mutates the jj store shared by every issue workspace.
Trailing newline in the marker: the five existing markers have none; matching them keeps the byte-exact check.
Child issues: one file through one PR has no independently integrable parts.
